reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000587 (the melody read from 000587a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. George C. Stebbins's dates (1846–1945) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Coles_Stebbins; CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000587a.nwc). The tune ends on F, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's. The year (1878) is from https://hymnary.org/tune/evening_prayer_stebbins (Composer: George C. Stebbins (1878)). Held back (25 Oct 2026): the line ends on soh and its second phrase has 10 notes for 7 syllables; check it against a printed copy before publishing.
